evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies wallet coin selection and transaction creation in src/wallet/spend.cpp and wallet RPCs.
rationale: Prevents transaction construction from failing with an internal 'map::at' exception when unconfirmed UTXO clusters exceed MiniMiner limits. Issue #29711 reported wallet funding failing with cryptic map::at exceptions when creating transactions against large mempool clusters; this PR replaces that failure with graceful error propagation via util::Result.
